title: Oral Thermometer Fever Clearance Time
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thermometer:reading
| search illness_id=* temp_c>=37.8
| stats earliest(_time) as fever_start latest(eval(if(temp_c<37.5,_time,null()))) as fever_clear by illness_id
| eval clearance_hours=round((fever_clear-fever_start)/3600,1)
| sort - clearance_hours
value: Clearance time turns scattered thermometer readings into a useful illness recovery measure.
implementation: Send oral-thermometer fever clearance time events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of oral-thermometer fever clearance time, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It lists what is happening with oral-thermometer fever clearance time, so odd changes stand out quickly.
